title: Not worth $100
text: Not worth $100. OK so this does sort of fit my couch but all pieces other than the arms were labeled back center and it was a huge pain to figure out what goes where. I am not sure I have all the correct pieces either because some do not fit great. The couch does look better than it did before. It was an older leather couch that began to peel. This couch is in my basement so I will keep the cover. However, there is no way I would use this for a couch in my living room or where people would see it. It looks like something in a college dorm room.
